snippet.description:
He's watching. 👁️

Humble beginnings...

🎮 Play the game & support development:

Connect with our Community! 💬

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/NKmxeE78jJ
Follow us on X (Twitter): https://x.com/RustyCatStudios
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@rustycatstudios

(YouTube algorithm)

ABOUT THE GAME :
Liminal Aero is an upcoming indie horror game and viral visual aesthetic. It seamlessly blends the glossy, optimistic design of Frutiger Aero (mid-2000s tech and corporate optimism) with the eerie, surreal atmosphere of liminal spaces and dreamcore.

ABOUT US : 
RustyCat Studios (formerly Fifoni) is a small, independent game development team dedicated to creating atmospheric, story-driven 3D games.

#LiminalAero #IndieHorror #FrutigerAero #Dreamcore #LiminalSpaces
